name: ExaBricks Rendering with RTX BVH
aliases: Ray tracing structured AMR data using ExaBricks
definition: A rendering method for Adaptive Block-Refined (ABR) data that uses hardware-accelerated RTX BVH traversal to iterate through regions, performing volume integration within each region and skipping empty space.
summary: ExaBricks Rendering with RTX BVH renders Adaptive Block-Refined volume data by replacing software traversal with hardware-accelerated RTX BVH traversal to skip empty space and avoid complex shader control flow.
